user.title: Connect an Aquarius Plant LED controller
user.description: Enter the controller's local address to read its six channel levels and current mode. Adjusting a validated channel selects Manual override and pauses the stored schedule. Use Resume schedule to return to it. Setup and startup only read state. Other controller profiles remain read-only.

reconfigure.title: Change controller address
reconfigure.description: Update this controller's address while preserving its device, entities, and names. Use the address of the same lamp: the protocol does not expose a verified immutable device identifier. The connection check only reads state.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a URL, path, or port.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the controller. Check its address and connectivity from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_response: The controller returned an unsupported or invalid protocol reply. No settings were changed.

abort.already_configured: This controller address and port are already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A connection check for this controller is already in progress.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Controller address updated. Device and entity identities were preserved.

state.validated_profile: Controller profile validated for Manual and Automatic

init.title: Channel colour labels
init.description: Name each channel after identifying its colour on this lamp. Keep the Channel A–F labels wherever the mapping is unknown. Labels must be distinct plain text, at most 40 characters. This changes display names only; it does not change the lamp output or entity IDs. Names you customized in Home Assistant take precedence.

error.invalid_labels: Provide one label for each of the six channels.
error.invalid_label: Enter 1–40 characters of plain text without markup or control characters.
error.duplicate_label: Give each channel a distinct label; upper and lower case do not distinguish labels.

abort.unsupported_label_version: These labels were saved by a newer integration version. Update the integration before editing them.
